title: CRM: a self-hosted CRM where a durable research agent runs on its own schedule
description:
This CRM puts a durable research agent at the center, with the database serving as its notebook. It runs on its own deployment and schedule, leasing rows from a work queue, so closing the browser doesn't stop it. The rule it never breaks is that nothing about a person is guessed. No tool accepts a confidence score, since a model grading its own certainty will flatter itself. Weak evidence becomes a suggestion a human settles.  #github #opensource 

https://github.com/trycompai/crm
